trials.instruction: Pick the fan with grid cover with the left arm and set it on the Black mat facing the robot.
Pick up the plastic fan with smooth finish and place it on the Orange mat with it facing the robot.
Pick the table fan with white finish with the left arm, ensure it faces the robot, and put it on the Indigo mat.
Pick up the portable white fan and ensure it faces the robot on the Brown mat.
Grab the lightweight plastic adjustable fan using the left arm and set it on the Brown colored mat, facing the robot.
Grab the small fan using the left arm and place it on the Blue mat ensuring it faces the robot.
Place the fan with rectangular base on the Navy mat and confirm it is pointing at the robot
Pick up the fan with round blades with the left arm, place it on the Red mat, and turn it toward the robot.
Grab the off-white fan and position it on the Purple mat, ensuring it faces the robot.
Take the curved plastic body small fan and place it on the Gray mat, making sure it faces the robot.
